papers.title: SpatialScout: Can VLM Agents Actively Explore and Map 3D Scenes?
papers.desc: Spatial intelligence requires agents to actively acquire visual evidence and integrate observations into a coherent representation of the three-dimensional world.

papers.title: Right Screen, Wrong Transition: World Models as Verifiers for GUI Agents
papers.desc: A login screen that appears after a tap on Sign in is expected; the same screen after a tap on View order is an attack.

papers.title: Retrieval Augmented Generation Compositionality
papers.desc: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds large language models in external knowledge.

papers.title: Quant-Arena: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Quantitative Trading Research
papers.desc: Quantitative research is an iterative loop: a researcher proposes a market hypothesis, implements it as an executable signal, tests it on historical data, and decides what to keep.

papers.title: From VLM Planners to Robotic Agents: Self-Evolving Harnesses for History-Dependent Manipulation
papers.desc: Vision-language-action (VLA) models achieve strong performance across embodied manipulation tasks by unifying visual understanding, language conditioning, and action generation.

papers.title: CompactSplat: Spatially Adaptive Gaussian Distribution for Feedforward Scene Reconstruction
papers.desc: Reconstructing 3D scenes from sparse views without per-scene optimization remains highly challenging, especially for recovering accurate geometry and fine textures.

papers.title: WorldStream: Streaming Interactive 3D Worlds with Hierarchical Planning and Persistent State
papers.desc: We present WorldStream, an open-ended 3D world model with three simultaneous capabilities: it extends playable terrain beyond any pre-specified map, acts on open-ended language in the running world, and restores visited places with their edits.

papers.title: From RL Papers to Framework Code: Inclusion and Review in Seven Open-Source Training Frameworks
papers.desc: Practitioners use reinforcement learning methods for language models through training frameworks, so a method that a framework includes is one configuration change away for its users.

papers.title: Hidden Messages Between Diffusion Language Model Agents: Causal Evidence for Latent Communication
papers.desc: Diffusion language models form answers through a sequence of revisable continuous states, but multi-agent systems usually discard those states and make agents communicate only after decoding text.

papers.title: DiffResearch: Accelerating Deep Research with Diffusion Language Models
papers.desc: Deep research systems iteratively plan, gather evidence, synthesize, and revise, making end-to-end latency a key bottleneck for interactive use.

papers.title: Design Anything, Design at Scale
papers.desc: As multimodal resources are transformed into media outputs, agentic AI is expected to stay aligned with design intent over long horizons.

papers.title: Looped Uniform Diffusion Language Models
papers.desc: Uniform diffusion language models (UDLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising sequences of ordinary vocabulary tokens, any of which may be corrupted and subsequently revised.

papers.title: RoboCasa-Shift: Stage-Aware Robustness Evaluation of Vision-Language-Action Policies in Long-Horizon Household Manipulation
papers.desc: Vision-language-action (VLA) robustness is commonly summarized by aggregate task success, which obscures how individual executions change under distribution shifts and where failures emerge in long-horizon tasks.

papers.title: Exploring The Empirical Privacy Landscape of Synthetic Data
papers.desc: Methods for training language models on sensitive data differ in how they balance capability gains against the risk of leaking private information.

papers.title: ToM2Vec: Continuous Theory-of-Mind Tokens for Multi-Agent Coordination
papers.desc: Forming an accurate theory-of-mind (ToM) is key to successful multi-agent collaboration and requires reasoning under uncertainty to capture multiple possible partner states.
